title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-ai-security-sales-executive-north-central

title: Bybit: Business Development Assistant
description: Headquarters: Europe - Remote About Us Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance. Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. About the Role *Pls kindly note this role has no base salary, it's commission based We are looking for a internationally minded Regional Business Development Specialist to drive the expansion of Bybit’s payments ecosystem across EU and emerging global corridors. This role will focus on community building, merchant acquisition, local payment partnerships, and strategic growth initiatives for Bybit Pay, Card, and Fiat channels. The ideal candidate has deep experience in payments, fintech, or crypto, strong local market understanding, and a proven track record of driving regional growth. Key Responsibilities: • Support market expansion for Bybit Pay across EU, building and owning the full growth pipeline • Acquire and manage merchants, payment gateways, fintech partners, Web3 projects, community leaders, and other growth channels. • Drive the end-to-end BD cycle: market mapping, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and partnership execution. • Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Card, Fiat Channels, Compliance, Payments Ops, Marketing) to activate and scale payment use cases. • Develop regional GTM strategies and identify high-potential payment corridors for crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto flows. • Support cross-border payment products, including settlement channels, payout solutions, and merchant integrations. • Provide market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive analysis to optimize product direction. • Represent Bybit in industry events, conferences, and ecosystem partnerships. Requirements: • 1+ years of experience in payments / fintech / PSP / acquiring / merchant growth / crypto BD. • Long-term overseas work or study experience (must-have). • Strong understanding of local payment rails, fiat/crypto conversion flows, card programs, and merchant needs. • Demonstrated success in driving regional growth or launching payment products in multiple markets. • Ability to work independently and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. • Native local language proficiency + strong English communication skills. • Network across fintech, Web3, PSPs, acquirers, or merchant ecosystems is highly preferred. Preferred Qualifications • Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for payments and cross-border movement. • Background working in global remote teams. • Prior experience with crypto exchanges, payment gateways, or card programs. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-business-development-assistant

title: Logicstics: Digital Marketing & Google Ads / AI Search Specialist
description: Headquarters: Philadelphia, PA, USA URL: https://logicstics.com Remote | Full-Time Logicstics is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing & Google Ads / AI Search Specialist to take ownership of our online lead generation strategy. We are an international moving and logistics company serving customers relocating throughout the world. This is a hands-on position. We are looking for someone who can build, manage, analyze, and improve campaigns themselves, not simply coordinate with outside agencies. What You'll Do You will be responsible for increasing qualified leads while continuously improving our cost per acquisition and overall marketing ROI. Your responsibilities will include: • Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, and remarketing • Conduct keyword research and continuously improve PPC campaign structure, targeting, bidding, ad copy, and landing pages • Monitor CPL, CPA, conversion rates, ROAS, impression share, search terms, and other performance metrics • Develop and execute our organic SEO strategy • Perform technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO • Identify content and keyword opportunities based on search intent • Improve rankings for high-value international moving and logistics searches • Develop strategies for AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews/Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search platforms • Improve how Logicstics and its content are discovered, cited, and recommended by AI search engines • Research emerging GEO/AEO/LLM optimization strategies and test what actually produces results • Create content strategies designed for both traditional search engines and AI search • Work with our developers to improve landing pages, conversion tracking, site structure, schema, page speed, and technical SEO • Build dashboards and reporting that clearly show leads, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and marketing ROI • Identify new digital channels and lead-generation opportunities • Use AI and automation tools to improve marketing research, content workflows, analysis, and campaign performance What We're Looking For: You should have proven hands-on experiece with: • Google Ads and PPC campaign management • Google Analytics 4 • Google Search Console • Google Tag Manager • SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms • Technical and on-page SEO • Keyword research and competitor analysis • Conversion tracking and attribution • Landing page optimization and CRO • Lead-generation campaigns • AI tools used for marketing, research, analysis, and content creation • AI search optimization, GEO, AEO, or a strong understanding of how brands gain visibility in generative search Experience marketing international moving, logistics, freight forwarding, transportation, relocation, or other high-value service businesses is a major advantage. What Matters Most We are not looking for someone who measures success by traffic, impressions, or the number of articles published. We care about qualified leads and profitable customer acquisition . You should be comfortable looking at a campaign and answering questions such as: Which keywords are generating booked customers? What are we paying for those customers? Where are we wasting money? Which organic pages generate actual inquiries? Why are competitors appearing in AI search results when we aren't? What should we change this month to generate more business? Requirements • 3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience • Demonstrable results managing Google Ads campaigns • Strong SEO knowledge • Strong analytical skills • Excellent written English • Experience working independently in a remote environment • Ability to manage projects and meet deadlines without constant supervision • Comfortable learning and testing emerging AI marketing technologies How to Apply Interested candidates should submit their resume and complete the required video interview as part of the application process. We're interested in what you've accomplished, not simply the tools you've used. Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted to schedule a live interview with our team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/logicstics-digital-marketing-google-ads-ai-search-specialist

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

description:
We are seeking a reliable and service-driven Client Support & Booking Assistant to help clients with planning needs, booking coordination, and general customer support. This remote role is ideal for someone who enjoys assisting others, communicates professionally, and thrives in a flexible work environment.

 

Responsibilities:

Assist clients with organizing booking details, dates, preferences, and service selections

Provide customer support through email, phone, and messaging in a professional manner

Help gather and maintain information needed for reservations and itinerary support

Coordinate booking details and follow up with clients as needed

Maintain accurate notes, client profiles, and documentation within our systems

Respond promptly to client questions and provide helpful guidance

Stay informed about available destinations, suppliers, and experience options

Support administrative tasks related to planning and booking services

Work collaboratively with the team to ensure a smooth and positive client experience

 

Skills & Qualifications:

title: Freshly Commerce: Technical Support Specialist
description: Headquarters: Waterloo, Canada URL: https://careers.freshlycommerce.com/ At Freshly Commerce, we're on a mission to build the logistics brain for commerce. Today, we help 25,000 Shopify brands simplify gnarly workflows like inventory, bundling, and order fulfillment (for even the world's largest brands like Sennheiser, Godiva, YAMAHA, and Stanley Drinkware). Tomorrow, we'll deliver intelligent automation that feels like an on-site operations team so merchants can focus on building their brand. We're a fully-remote and bootstrapped company with teammates around the world. We love what we do and love who we build for. We're a small team of 9 (3 Support specialists) who amplify each other's work by working closely together: dev with support, support with marketing, and so on. We're curious, kind, scrappy yet rigorous, and highly intentional. If this sounds like the type of team you'd like to be a part of, we'd love to hear from you. About this role In this role, you'll have significant ownership of your work, make impactful decisions daily, and report directly to the founders. This is a full-time remote position open to candidates in all timezones. Support is the foundation of everything we do. Our apps have consistently maintained high ratings on the Shopify App Store because our support team genuinely cares about helping merchants succeed. As one of our early support hires, you'll get to know our products inside and out and become a go-to expert on how things work under the hood. We hire slowly and keep the bar high, so the people you work with every day will be some of the best you’ve worked with. You'll be joining a small but growing support team, where we all wear many hats. You'll need strong troubleshooting instincts, a curious mind, and a willingness to get into the weeds. You should feel comfortable making judgment calls on UX or product questions, and know when something needs to be escalated. There's plenty of room to grow with us. What we're looking for • Somone who fixes the process while you’re fixing the ticket. • Someone who's comfortable diving into technical issues and can confidently support merchants over email and through clear, helpful video recordings. • A strong track record in customer-facing roles, with a focus on delivering thoughtful, efficient support. You listen closely, ask the right questions, and know how to turn a frustrating situation into a positive experience. • Good judgment around what needs to be escalated and what doesn't. You'll know when to loop in teammates and how to make that handoff seamless for the merchant. • An eye for patterns and the ability to turn merchant feedback into actionable insights for our product and engineering teams. • The ability to prioritize effectively. You can assess what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait, especially when everything feels like it needs attention. • Comfort with change. You stay calm when the product evolves and enjoy picking up new knowledge as you go. • A team-first mindset. You jump in to support others, document what you've learned, and share what's working so we can all move faster together. • Strong communication skills, especially in writing. You know how to keep things clear, friendly, and easy to follow, whether you're talking to a merchant or a teammate. • Natural troubleshooting instincts. You enjoy working on tricky issues and figuring out what's actually going on, not just treating the symptoms. • Great attention to detail. You care about getting the small things right, because they add up to a better experience. • A curious mind. You're always learning, always testing, always a few steps ahead. • The ability to explain complex ideas in a simple way, especially for merchants who aren't technical. Experience • Previous experience in technical support at a SaaS or tech company • Familiarity with HelpScout or other ticketing systems • Hands-on knowledge of front-end development (HTML, CSS, browser dev tools) • Working understanding of REST APIs and common data formats like JSON or XML • Comfort with debugging using Chrome DevTools, especially for browser or front-end issues • Knowledge of how HTTP and DNS work • Experience reading API documentation and troubleshooting third-party integrations or custom app setups • Some exposure to GraphQL APIs Bonus experience • Shopify theme development and Liquid: Knowing how themes interact with app blocks, line item properties, and cart/checkout logic helps when diagnosing visual or UX issues on merchant stores. • Understanding of Shopify's admin and storefront APIs: Familiarity with how Shopify's APIs behave (especially in headless or custom setups) can be useful when troubleshooting sync issues, metafields, or app-triggered updates. Beyond expertise, success in this role means embodying 3 core values • Resourcefulness: You're relentlessly resourceful and always find ways to achieve the highest standards of quality. You know where to look and whom to consult when faced with challenges. • Ownership: You take complete ownership and pride in your work. This means deeply understanding our existing and prospective merchants, as well as our product. • Communication: You're clear, thoughtful, and intentional in how you communicate with both merchants and teammates. You surface issues early, share relevant context, and keep things moving without needing constant follow-up. We're async by default If you've ever ended a day of back-to-back meetings wondering when you were supposed to get any actual work done, we get it. We've been there. We've built a culture that protects time, encourages focus, and trusts you to do great work without constant check-ins. We meet once a week for 30 min on Mondays. The rest of the time, we default to async: clear Slack threads, thoughtful Looms, and shared docs. Perks & compensation • Competitive salary + annual pay increases. • $1,000 annual workspace stipend for laptop, headphones, or that standing desk you've been eyeing. • Flexible hours. Work when you're most productive. We just ask for ~4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (9 am to 5 pm EST). • Flexible vacation policy. Take the time you need, no arbitrary caps. Our interview process • Application & short demo video: Submit your application plus the two-minute recorded screen-share. Both founders watch every submission, so take the chance to show how you think, not just what you click. • Conversation with the co-founders (30 min): Meet Lichen (CEO) and Basil (CTO). We'll talk about projects you've worked on, how you approach support and problem-solving, and what kind of work energizes you. • Paid take-home assignment: We'll send you a real-life merchant scenario to work through and pay you $100 USD for your time. • Reference chats: We'll speak with two people you've worked with to understand your collaboration style and strengths. • Offer: If it's a match, we move quickly, answer any final questions, and welcome you to the team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/freshly-commerce-technical-support-specialist-1
